help.hint.tray_pin.title: Heading of the one-time first-board hint that points toward the WidgetBoard tray icon. 2 to 7 words.
help.hint.tray_pin.body: Text of the one-time first-board hint. Explain right-click for the menu and left-click for show or hide. The last sentence is for users who cannot see the icon: Windows hides new tray icons behind the ^ button (Show hidden icons) at the right end of the taskbar, and the icon is dragged from there onto the taskbar. The card shows a small animation of that drag. 3 short sentences.
